name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-yurarin-boo
title: Redrawn Styled Yurarin Boo
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for smkdan's SML Yurarin Boo custom sprite, meant to resemble the enemy's official artwork.

It comes in 2 flavors: Classic (meant to work with any palette); and Artwork Accurate (meant to go with SMW Redrawn's Palette A, thus requiring some prior tinkering with Pixi's CFG editor).

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.
